core_design.fewshot: Five uniform examples from full language pool, set seeds 42/43/44, each repeated three times. No conditioning on gold or post-draw rebalancing. Report annotation coverage.
core_design.interpretation: RAG versus FS compares the RAG package: selected examples, definitions/guidelines and different source caution. It is not a pure causal retrieval-only effect.
core_design.later: HateCheck/TEST and claim-bearing SQ1 counterparts separately frozen later; Priority 3 and LaTeX excluded.
core_design.missing_gold: Per-dimension masks preserve None versus []; legal independent of hate gate. Freeze scoring/failure rules in execution preparation.
core_design.pairing: Same saved prediction per language/item/condition/repeat reused across overlapping endpoint rosters, never new independent observations.
core_design.planned_contrasts: Full-minus-small RAG, and full RAG versus annotation-eligible few-shot on each endpoint. Uniform few-shot and zero-shot remain context/control comparisons. Report FS between-set and within-set variation separately. Core RAG/FS is a package contrast, not isolated example selection.
core_design.reuse: New RAG/ZS/FS execution planned for contemporaneous core comparisons. Historical results retained separately; German reuse needs saved-message/index equivalence before any later amendment.
core_design.staging: Budget is for the whole matrix, not one uninterrupted batch. Freeze resumable language/condition blocks and stop for review after each major batch.
core_design.strong_fewshot_control: Also sample five uniformly from the full pool annotated for the requested head (fine English heads restricted to TRAIN gate=True, as encoder masks). Use the same three predetermined set seeds and three decoder repeats. Retain annotated empty legal lists. No current input gold/text similarity used in selection. This is a separately named task-aware control; uniform draws remain reported.
